ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and send the driver's account for review of the false "I'm Here" tap + flag_account.

rejected_claims.reason: The recorded tap at 22:37:10 (F5) only satisfies NS-1(i); NS-1 requires all three conditions, and the same fact fixes the tap 1000 m from the pickup (F5), with no arrival ever logged (F4), so the tap does not make the no-show fee payable [F4][F5][NS-1].

The driver's account of waiting at the pickup (F12) conflicts with the GPS/timeline records placing him stationary 993 m away with 0 s inside the radius (F2, F5), and system records override statements, so the waiting element of NS-1(iii) is not met [F2][F5][F12][NS-1].
This claim is conceded and in fact supports the rider; it is not a ground against the refund, since NS-1(ii) failing triggers NS-2's full refund [F1][F4][F5][NS-1][NS-2].
Conceded and likewise supports the rider; the failure of NS-1(iii) confirms NS-2 applies rather than defeating the claim [F1][F2][F5][NS-1][NS-2].
Not rejected — the driver advocate's own request for a full $6.61 refund (F3, F7) matches the ruling; it is recorded here only as it overlaps the rider's C6 request [F3][F7][NS-2].
